STEP 1 - Scene: This is a Mediterranean or Greek-style plate with grilled meats (a meatball or patty, pork or lamb pieces, herbed shredded meat), roasted potatoes, green peppers, and a piece of pita with tomato.

STEP 2 - Vessel: The square white dinner plate is about 26 cm across. I treated its area as roughly 600 cm² (a square plate covers more than a 26 cm circle would).

STEP 3 - Items:
- Grilled meat patties or pieces
- Herbed shredded meat
- Roasted potatoes with oil and herbs
- Green peppers
- Pita bread with tomato and cheese
- Oil

STEP 4 - Area (total covered ≈ 75%):

| Item | Share of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Meat patties/pieces | 17% | 102 cm² |
| Herbed shredded meat | 10% | 60 cm² |
| Potatoes | 20% | 120 cm² |
| Green peppers | 15% | 90 cm² |
| Pita | 13% | 78 cm² |

STEP 5 - Volume (area × height):
- Meat: 102 × 2.5 = 255 ml
- Shredded meat: 60 × 2 = 120 ml
- Potatoes: 120 × 2.5 = 300 ml
- Peppers: 90 × 1 = 90 ml
- Pita: 78 × 1 = 78 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (volume × bulk density):
- Meat: 255 × 0.9 = 230 g
- Shredded meat: 120 × 0.8 = 96 g
- Potatoes: 300 × 0.6 = 180 g
- Peppers: 90 × 0.5 = 45 g
- Pita: 78 × 0.5 = 39 g
- Oil: about 10 g

STEP 7 - Energy:

| Item | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Meat | 230 | 250 | 575 |
| Shredded meat | 96 | 220 | 211 |
| Potatoes | 180 | 130 | 234 |
| Peppers | 45 | 25 | 11 |
| Pita with filling | 39 | 270 | 105 |
| Oil | 10 | 884 | 88 |

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total is about 600 g and 1,224 kcal. That is plausible for a well-loaded mixed grill plate.
